answer: The brazier's kettles hang in every kitchen in the parish, blackened by years of fires. Proof of brazier kettle via solder seam log — a kettle the brazier solders only after 15 kettles run true, each kettle tinned by the brazier himself. The ridge anneals the copper sheets before they are shaped. The plume keeps the solder and flux at hand. The spiral shelves the finished kettles till market day. A forger must solder 15 kettles, tin 15 kettles and prove 15 kettles true, three days over the fire for kettles that still weep at the joint.
